doc.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]

title: The wild bebopper and upcoming plans
summary: He agrees he is a wild bebopper and lists a Brian Lynch record date, Smoke, a jazz cruise and travel.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I feel you are. But you also, you know you said this about yourself, there’s a great promo that’s out about “Reverence,” your latest recording, and one of the things you said about yourself, “I really like the language of bebop which allows for a broad range of expression, but I’m not a civilized bebopper, I’m a wild bebopper and I might go anywhere from that jumping off spot.
Oh well yeah, yup, yup, yup. Yeah. I try, and I will if I hear it.

Well I’m traveling a lot. Let me see, I’ve got a record date that I’m going to do with Brian Lynch coming up in November. You know Brian Lynch, really wonderful trumpet player, a good friend. And let me see, I’ll probably do Smoke again at some point next year. Oh and I got a boat — a jazz cruise coming up in January. And I’m working quite a bit, I’m in Los Angeles in a couple of weeks from now, so I’ve been traveling quite a bit you know. So it’s been good. Since Covid kind of calmed down a bit I have been working a lot.
